|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/tatooineslavequarters.html</ref>

Cool! Another 2/0 site like [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]]'s Hut for [[Tatooine]]! With "Shmi's Hut" you can get her out to quickly set up for [[Threepio With His Parts Showing]]. Although both characters are not very strong, their strength lies in their game text.

One good use of another 0 Dark Side Force icon location is to set up [[Tatooine]] so that you can control where the actions take place. By placing locations in a certain order, you can make [[Tatooine]] into a rat trap for the Dark Side. You can put one battleground in between the Slave Quarters and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]]'s Hut. Doing so will force the opponent to deploy to the middle and if they try to escape, you can nab them at either non-battleground with less fear of a counterattack. Another way is to put both Slave Quarters and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]]'s Hut together to create a partial haven for utility characters (e.g., [[Figrin D'an]] or [[Oola]]).
